description: A shielded (PrivacyPreserving) token Send on the public LEZ testnet at RISC0_DEV_MODE=0. The on-chain transaction carries a real Groth16 proof in its witness set (271,076 bytes, type byte 0x01), not a 271-byte public transaction with no proof.

transactions.name: shielded-send-01
transactions.effect: holder balance 100 -> 90; 10 tokens sent to the private recipient account

note_on_ephemerality: As with all public-testnet evidence, a chain reset by the operator invalidates the hashes and snapshots above; the reproducible test regenerates equivalent evidence against whatever testnet is live. The on-chain size and type byte are the invariant: a PrivacyPreserving transaction at DEV_MODE=0 is hundreds of kilobytes and carries the proof; a Public transaction is a few hundred bytes and does not.
